move.text:
Hello,

Hi, thanks for the reply. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We can do the 1500 ppm you asked for, but it means more checks on our side, so the best we can do is €46.50 per unit. So our current Angebot is a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. 

We don't share detailed cost breakdowns, but I can assure you we're giving you a good deal. Material accounts for about 30 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351. 

If you want to see more movement on the price, maybe we can talk about increasing the volume or getting paid faster? Which volume can you commit to? This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. However, the quality record figures you cite do not match the records. That costs trust. I checked those scorecard numbers you sent, but they don't match what we have on our end. Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
